name: Presidential Alert
look: A close-up photo of a hand holding an iPhone. A pop-up notification titled "Presidential Alert" covers the home screen, with an empty white message area and a light blue "Dismiss" button below it. App icons such as Maps, Weather and FaceTime show around the edges.
use: The blank message area holds an urgent, official-sounding announcement about something trivial or personal, as if a small everyday event deserved a nationwide emergency broadcast to every phone.
slots: the alert message, in the blank space under "Presidential Alert"
examples: Your mom just used your full name. Please return home immediately.
The pizza rolls have been in the oven for 45 minutes. Someone check on them.
describe: phone pop up that says presidential alert with a dismiss button
hand holding an iphone with an emergency alert notification
official government warning message on a cell phone screen
blank alert box on top of the iphone home screen
urgent text notification you can only dismiss
origin: Parodies the "Presidential Alert" phone notification from the first nationwide US Wireless Emergency Alert test in 2018.
